description: NIST's CTC-02, its AP242 e2 edition's solid #14911 (the committed excerpt real/nist-ctc-02-ap242-mitred-pipes-s5), drilled along its first principal axis by its battery's cylinder: the drill's wall f636 crosses the bicubic B-spline face f520 (16 × 4 spans, open in both directions, polynomial), and its box reaches f544 too, the same kind. Arris builds it since plans/nurbs-analytic-section step 7, checker green, and removes 143 792 mm³ of the part with the drill's wall. Open CASCADE's solid removes 69 676, half: its own solid classifier on the part puts 145 600 ± 2 900 of the drill's cylinder inside the part (40 000 samples), and its cut and common agree with each other, so its boolean misses a wall. The fixture waits for an oracle that can be held to a closed form
